01  /  Allocation rule

How the project count was arrived at

Every course carries at least 100 projects. Where the registered strength demands more than 100 to respect the three-team ceiling, the count was raised accordingly.

Constraints applied

  1. Each project is executed by a team of 4 students.
  2. A given project may be allotted to at most 3 teams, so at most 12 students work on any one problem statement.
  3. Each course carries a minimum of 100 projects, regardless of strength.
  4. Teams are distributed round-robin, so the load per project is as even as the arithmetic allows.
teams = ⌈ students ÷ 4 ⌉   |   projects = max( 100, ⌈ teams ÷ 3 ⌉ )

02  /  Course-wise allocation

Allocation summary

“Reserve” projects are surplus to the current strength — they are available for reallocation, for students repeating the course, or for teams who wish to swap a problem statement.
